entities.summary: Margaret Ivy Amoakohene is a Ghanaian academic and diplomat. She has served in various sectors of governance and academia. She was Ghana's High Commissioner to Canada in the John Agyekum Kufour administration. She is a senior lecturer and acting director of the School of Communication Studies at the University of Ghana, Legon. She was member of the Council of State under the administration of Nana Akuffo-Addo.
